applies_to.launch: COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH=<file> (the CLI's own OTel file exporter; content capture as configured)
applies_to.selection: the version the capture discovered with copilot --version; resource service.version also states it

executor: journal-ocsf-writer CopilotOtelMapper (direct Java); one record at a time
identity: copilot.otel.identity.v1: gen_ai.conversation.id is the session; gen_ai.response.id is a chat span's provider call id (response_uid); gen_ai.tool.call.id is an execute_tool span's model-facing call id; github.copilot.service_request_id and github.copilot.interaction_id are kept in data and turn_uid; spanId is the native uid
content_settings: message, system and tool content attributes (gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.system_instructions, gen_ai.tool.definitions, gen_ai.tool.call.arguments, gen_ai.tool.call.result) are present only under content capture; an absent attribute is absent, never empty

rules.owner: response_uid = gen_ai.response.id; usage from gen_ai.usage.* (absent cache-write is absent); github.copilot.cost as kind 3 multiplier, github.copilot.nano_aiu as kind 4

tool_call_uid = gen_ai.tool.call.id; arguments parsed from gen_ai.tool.call.arguments; tool_result.data = gen_ai.tool.call.result (text); status ERROR as failure with error.type (layer 3); MCP target from github.copilot.tool.parameters.mcp_server_name/mcp_tool_name, no protocol projection
tool_definitions from gen_ai.tool.definitions (function declarations); settings: agent type and MCP server names
run-scope usage (scope 4, scope total); github.copilot.cost as kind 3 with unit multiplier sum (the sum of the run's per-call multipliers; never premium requests); nano-AIU kind 4

selector.type: metric, or a span of another operation

rules.selector: a record that is not one JSON object

rules.owner: the record retained whole with the failure

candidate.status: EXPERIMENTAL candidate (2026-10-24): tested on one sanitized live 1.0.100 run (copilot-otel-1) and its final assembly; not admitted: no field-disposition catalog or oracle profile yet; tested candidate behaviour is not approved support

quantity_semantics: Selected execution quantities retain their exact reported value and source path, and add the extension-defined common concept and measurement_window. Model configuration limits are capacities, never consumption. Unknown-unit quantities remain unresolved.
